## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Ávila, Spain. It starts at 217 Camino de Marañones.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Welcome to El Bosque Encantado, a wonderland of living plant sculptures in Sierra Oeste, located an hour outside of Madrid. With over 300 botanical wonders and 17 trails spanning 30,000 m2, this magical botanical garden is a feast for the senses.
>
> Explore the labyrinth and marvel at the outdoor mineral exhibition, or bask in the beauty of the mountain of bonsai trees. Even the weather can't put a damper on your experience – the geodesic dome is equipped to handle both hot and cold days.
>
> But the real magic happens at night when El Bosque Encantado transforms into El Bosque Iluminado– a magical experience included in your ticket. Millions of colorful lights flood the park, creating an enchanting atmosphere as you stroll along the twinkling path.
>
> Children enjoy the tour with colored lanterns that can be purchased at the ticket booth.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €24.06. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 22 ratings and 14 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
